changes_from_v0: Adds named_function and the named_functions registry (custom derivative kernels rebuilt with Carbon's own rule); custom_jvp_call is refused unless lowering recognizes it as a registered kernel; aten.relu lowers to the named relu.
changes_from_v6: Adds aten.neg, aten.log, aten.leaky_relu, aten.any.dim and aten._upsample_bicubic2d_aa; admits argument forms named by an aten entry's `forms`: strided slice_scatter, transposed convolution, static_outer aten.index.Tensor (several static indices broadcasting as an outer product), integer aten.fmod.Scalar and complex aten.sum.dim_IntList, with floor and integer rem folded into static indices (CODANO); records aten.rand_like as refused. Carbon ops, named functions and caps are unchanged.
changes_from_v7: OWNER-GRAPH-OPS-FREEDOM-01 (2026-10-25): every pure, deterministic array op is admitted: inverse and hyperbolic trigonometry, atan2, cbrt, exp2, ceil, round, clamp, is_finite, the gamma/Bessel special functions, bitwise shifts, boolean and cumulative reductions, stack/unstack, and the linear-algebra primitives (cholesky, triangular_solve, eigh, lu, qr, svd; jnp.linalg.solve and inv lower through lu and triangular_solve). Containment is unchanged: custom_call, callbacks, infeed/outfeed, unseeded RNG, sharding and unbounded loops stay refused.

named_functions_scan: Pinned JAX 0.10.2: every public function in jax.nn, jax.numpy and jax.scipy.special was traced; 32 contain a custom_jvp_call. A kernel is a function whose trace is one custom_jvp_call: 19 distinct kernels (softplus is logaddexp). The rest call a kernel (hard_sigmoid, hard_silu, hard_swish, mish, log_sigmoid) or hold several or an internal one (sinc, entr, expi, expn, kl_div, rel_entr, wofz) and lower through their kernels or are refused.
rule: Any op not listed is refused. Refused entries are listed to record the decision. Review entries are admitted for development only and flagged; each needs a decision before Level 4 v1. Roles: forward (inference graph), init (parameter construction from Carbon's key), loss.
status: DEVELOPMENT prospective v8: v7 plus every pure, deterministic array op the graph route can run (OWNER-GRAPH-OPS-OPEN-01, Validator VALIDATOR_GRAPH_OPS_V8_RULINGS_20261025); v0-v7 bytes and historical graph interpretation remain unchanged.
